register.labelZh: KNOCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: knock about 或 knock around 可以表示與某人來往、在某地四處遊歷,或某物長時間隨處放着。；KNOCK 片語動詞可以描述某人跌倒、失去知覺、被撞離單車,也可以表示物件被碰翻、撞壞或敲進某處。；你可以用 knock off 表示下班、knock somebody back 表示花費、knock something off a price 表示減價,以及 knock somebody down 表示議價。；KNOCK 可以表示迅速喝下飲品、迅速完成作品、迅速做成某物,或在網球比賽前擊球熱身。；knock it off 用來叫某人停止;knock yourself out 則表示對方可以儘管去做。
register.summaryEn: Knock about or knock around can describe spending time with people, travelling through places or things that have been lying unused for a long time. KNOCK expressions can show a person falling, becoming unconscious, being forced off a bicycle, or an object being tipped over, broken or driven into a surface. You can use knock off for finishing work, knock somebody back for cost, knock something off a price for a reduction and knock somebody down when bargaining. KNOCK can describe drinking something quickly, producing a piece of work quickly, making something quickly or warming up before a tennis match. Knock it off tells somebody to stop. Knock yourself out tells somebody they may go ahead and do as much as they like.
